decisions.title: Autonomous agent option C with tools and durable memory
decisions.context: Owner explicitly chose option C; practical tasks are primary, not avatar realism.
decisions.decision: Keep core task orchestration and memory first.
decisions.revisit_when: Product goals or user priority change.

decisions.title: Single-user modular monolith on Windows
decisions.context: Lower operational cost than microservices for one host and user. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Python application with clean ports; workers logical.
decisions.revisit_when: Multiple independent users or remote deployment needs arise.

decisions.title: SQLite with FTS5 as initial durable store
decisions.context: Local low-administration default with versioned migrations. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Use abstraction for semantic index and potential PostgreSQL replacement.
decisions.revisit_when: Concurrency, scale or retrieval benchmark fails.

decisions.title: LLM/provider-agnostic identity and model router
decisions.context: Preserve user continuity across local and cloud models. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Never store identity or task truth in model weights alone.
decisions.revisit_when: No provider-independent evaluation succeeds.

decisions.title: Local by default; cloud explicit opt-in
decisions.context: Respects privacy and offline utility without giving up quality. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Cloud is gated and task-sensitive.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner supplies different data transfer constraints.

decisions.title: Tool registry and authorization before execution
decisions.context: Action correctness and side-effect safety cannot be delegated to LLM. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Typed tools, policy gates, audit and verifier.
decisions.revisit_when: Security review finds stronger isolation needed.

decisions.title: Versioned facts/events and project-scoped retrieval
decisions.context: Source lineage and contradictory decisions must remain inspectable. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Store provenance and supersession, not overwrite summaries.
decisions.revisit_when: Storage benchmark or privacy requirement changes.

decisions.title: Controlled skill evolution; no autonomous core changes
decisions.context: Useful improvement without uncontrolled code execution.
decisions.decision: Sandbox proposals, tests, owner promotion.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner approves alternative governance mechanism.

decisions.title: No automatic weight fine-tuning in initial releases
decisions.context: Insufficient curated examples and benchmark at project start.
decisions.decision: Retain data selection/evaluation possibility later.
decisions.revisit_when: Sufficient training data and success metric exist.

decisions.title: Browser via Playwright where suitable; MCP optional
decisions.context: Browser automation needs deterministic safety and observation.
decisions.decision: Treat MCP as adapter, not central dependency.
decisions.revisit_when: Browser/tool benchmarks demand other implementation.

decisions.title: Telegram bot before personal-account integration
decisions.context: Separate channel simpler to secure, test and audit.
decisions.decision: Stage personal-account integration later.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner changes integration priorities.

decisions.title: JSON canonical specs, Markdown explanatory documents
decisions.context: Stable IDs, easy AI indexing and stdlib validation. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Keep schemas and traceability authoritative.
decisions.revisit_when: Schema complexity warrants another IDL.

decisions.title: No default multi-agent orchestration
decisions.context: One orchestrator and bounded tools simpler to debug and evaluate.
decisions.decision: Multi-agent only after measured benefit.
decisions.revisit_when: Parallel benchmark demonstrates advantage.

decisions.title: Conservative action approvals and no automatic external sends
decisions.context: Avoid unapproved communication, purchases and OS changes. Baseline adopted for initial implementation; future changes require superseding ADR and compatible migration.
decisions.decision: Approval bound to concrete effect/recipient/target.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner refines authorization rules.

decisions.title: Select Qwen3.5 9B as default local model, without comparative model testing
decisions.context: Owner explicitly selected Qwen3.5 9B for the initial agent and declined model comparison tests. This selects a planned implementation default, not an installed runtime.
decisions.decision: Use Ollama tag qwen3.5:9b by default. Implement only this local model first. Retain provider-neutral contracts but do not schedule A/B model benchmarks, alternatives or model-ranking as release prerequisites. Retain minimal startup smoke checks, functional verification and security tests.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner explicitly changes model choice or later requests evaluations.

decisions.title: Store assistant and runtime state in portable G-drive home
decisions.context: Owner requests one dedicated G: directory containing project code, local model, history, memory and supporting files for migration and management.
decisions.decision: Use G:\Assistant as default home. Repo in repo/, Ollama models in models/ollama, durable data in data/{db,history,memory,identity,skills}, work in workspace/, logs, backups and cache separated. Resolve paths through ASSISTANT_ROOT; OLLAMA_MODELS for Ollama. Never silently fall back to C:. Keep secrets and runtime data out of Git, protect backups and validate restoration.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner changes storage or destination disk.

decisions.title: Trusted action classification by exact operation and target
decisions.context: An LLM cannot assign its own privileges, and an integration like GitHub supports both read and externally mutating calls.
decisions.decision: The trusted registry determines side-effect class, operation identity, resource scope and sensitivity from validated arguments; ToolRequest contains only intent, never authoritative risk class. Separate read and write capabilities; externally mutating GitHub actions require approval. Default deny on ambiguity.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner approves new bounded policy after threat review.

decisions.title: Minimal safe idempotent task recovery in M1
decisions.context: M1 acceptance SCN-005 requires restart-safe state, while original advanced scheduler task was M3.
decisions.decision: M1 must persist intent, step/action IDs, approval and pre/post side-effect journal, expose blocked/needs_reconciliation, and refuse automatic replay of uncertain effects; M3 implements advanced scheduling and connector-specific reconciliation.
decisions.revisit_when: M1 acceptance scenarios or connector guarantees change.
decisions.owner: project owner via requested doc-gap closure

decisions.title: Single runtime root and environment derivation
decisions.context: Separate absolute G-drive environment paths contradict migration via ASSISTANT_ROOT.
decisions.decision: ASSISTANT_ROOT is the only canonical absolute application path. Resolve data/db/history/memory/identity/skills/workspace/logs/backups/cache relative to spec/storage-config.json. Generate OLLAMA_MODELS from the effective root at host provisioning, never assume .env controls Ollama Desktop. No fallback to C:.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner changes workspace policy.

decisions.title: Architecture baseline v1 gate and contract coverage
decisions.context: A coding agent can omit untracked requirements or trust syntactically valid but structurally invalid JSON.
decisions.decision: Every non-deprecated requirement has an implementation or explicitly deferred task and acceptance evidence; enforce relationship in CI. Validate schema fixtures with JSON Schema 2020-12 and run on Windows and Linux. Functional safety checks remain mandatory; do not compare LLM alternatives.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner changes development process or validation policy.
decisions.owner: project owner via requested doc-gap closure
